instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Stop sharing one of my show-rule presets with someone", and give it type (The id of a type you keep); principal (The person or account); grant (Where the type's share is kept: sharing:show-types-shared:<type id> (see-when-things-show names it for each type as grant)).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:stop-sharing-a-show-type and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Takes one person or account out of a shared type's grant (sharing:show-types-shared:<id>), so their share key reads nothing any more; the others it is shared with keep reading it.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: @own-records (workspace:read).
